errors.evidence: This statement claims there are no visually highlighted elements. However, the chart features a prominent, thick vertical black line separating the data between 2014 and 2015, which is a form of visual emphasis or annotation.
The description identifies the chart as a bar chart ('стълбова диаграма'), which is an oversimplification. It is a combination chart that includes both bars and a line plot with two separate y-axes.
